name: sq-comex-portal
description: Portal COMEX (sq-comex-updates) - SPA React + Firebase Auth. Build vai para dist/ e deploy usa firebase.portal-comex.json para o site sq-comex-updates-3d22f no Firebase Hosting.

scripts.test:rules: node scripts/with-jdk.mjs node node_modules/firebase-tools/lib/bin/firebase.js emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-sqcomex "npx vitest run emulator --no-file-parallelism"
scripts.test:notifications: node scripts/with-jdk.mjs node node_modules/firebase-tools/lib/bin/firebase.js emulators:exec --only firestore,functions --project demo-sqcomex "npx vitest run notifications.triggers --no-file-parallelism"
scripts.test:sync-news: node scripts/with-jdk.mjs node node_modules/firebase-tools/lib/bin/firebase.js emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-sqcomex "npx vitest run syncExternalNews.e2e --no-file-parallelism"
scripts.test:sync-bar: node scripts/with-jdk.mjs node node_modules/firebase-tools/lib/bin/firebase.js emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-sqcomex "npx vitest run syncBarStatus.e2e --no-file-parallelism"
scripts.test:audit-status: node scripts/with-jdk.mjs node node_modules/firebase-tools/lib/bin/firebase.js emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-sqcomex "npx vitest run auditCollectionStatus.e2e --no-file-parallelism"
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/with-jdk.mjs node node_modules/firebase-tools/lib/bin/firebase.js emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,storage --project demo-sqcomex "npx playwright test"
